source_caption_text:
DJ Pauly D proposed to his girlfriend Nikki Hall in the middle of his show ❤️💍🥹

The Jersey Shore star paused his DJ set at OMNIA Dayclub in Caesars Palace, brought Nikki onstage and got down on one knee in front of the crowd. She said yes, and the two are now engaged. 

Pauly and Nikki first met on MTV’s Double Shot at Love in 2019 and later began dating after reconnecting during the show’s second season. They’ve been together for about six years, and their relationship has also been seen on Jersey Shore: Family Vacation. 

From meeting on a dating show to getting engaged during Pauly’s Vegas set, this was a full-circle moment for the couple 🥹❤️
